# 楞伽經疏

**ID:** X0322
**Volume:** X17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0322

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X322 in two fascicles is an anonymous Tang-period commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The catalog meta has no author entry, and the witness preserved in the *Xuzangjing* is similarly without an attribution-line. The doctrinal vocabulary is consistent with the late-Tang or early-Sòng phase of *Laṅkāvatāra* commentary; the treatment of the *yuánchéngshí* 圓成實 (parispanna) and the *wàngxiǎng zìxìng* 妄想自性 (parikalpita) categories suggests a Yogācāra-influenced commentator active after [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) and the assimilation of [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80)'s [T672](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0329).

**Abstract**

The work is one of the few extant Tang-period anonymous *Laṅkāvatāra* commentaries, preserved only in the Wànzì *Xuzangjing*. Date bracket conservatively follows the Tang span, with a more probable concentration in the eighth or ninth century (700–900). The text is fragmentary: only a *juànshàng* portion is preserved in the *Xuzangjing* compilation, with the second fascicle either lost or never extant. The opening lemma — on the *yuánchéngshí* nature being free of being-and-non-being, with the *wàngxiǎng* (parikalpita) constructed-nature giving rise to the duality of being-and-non-being — is consistent with a Yogācāra-affiliated reading of the *Laṅkāvatāra* in the Cíēn 慈恩 tradition.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670).
